            }
        }

    String readString() throws IOException {
        while (!tok.hasMoreTokens()) {

        }

    }

    }

    long readLong() throws IOException {

    }

    double readDouble() throws IOException {

            time();

            e.printStackTrace();
            System.exit(-1);
        }
    }

    int[][][][] dp;
    char[] s;

            if (c == 'V') {
                v--;
                if (v == 0 && target == 'V') return answer;
                if (v < 0) answer++;

                k--;
                if (k == 0 && target == 'K') return answer;

            }

            if (s[i] == 'V') {
                vcnt++;
                continue;
            }
            if (s[i] == 'K') {
                kcnt++;
                continue;
            }
            xcnt++;
            s[i] = 'X';
        }

            for (int[][] xx : x) {
                for (int[] xxx : xx) {
                    Arrays.fill(xxx, INF);
                }
            }
        }
        dp[0][0][0][0] = dp[0][0][0][1] = dp[0][0][0][2] = 0;
        for (int v = 0; v <= vcnt; v++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= kcnt; k++) {
                for (int x = 0; x <= xcnt; x++) {
                    int rv = v + 1 <= vcnt ? count(s, 'V', v + 1, k, x) : 0;
                    int rk = k + 1 <= kcnt ? count(s, 'K', v, k + 1, x) : 0;
                    int rx = x + 1 <= xcnt ? count(s, 'X', v, k, x + 1) : 0;

                    for (int now = 0; now < 3; now++) {
                        if (v + 1 <= vcnt) dp[v + 1][k][x][0] = Math.min(dp[v + 1][k][x][0], dp[v][k][x][now] + rv);
                        if (now != 0 && k + 1 <= kcnt) dp[v][k + 1][x][1] = Math.min(dp[v][k + 1][x][1], dp[v][k][x][now] + rk);
                        if (x + 1 <= xcnt) dp[v][k][x + 1][2] = Math.min(dp[v][k][x + 1][2], dp[v][k][x][now] + rx);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int res = INF;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            res = Math.min(res, dp[vcnt][kcnt][xcnt][i]);
        }
        out.println(res);
    }
}
